system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: we prompt the LLM to emit a policytemplate in which tunable constants are parameterized as explicit compiler flags
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt mechanism not shown; inferred from prose.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Magellan uses AlphaEvolve equipped with an LLM to modify a source file that contains the policy we want to improve. The policy-relevant regions are marked with EVOLVE-BLOCK comments
env_context_strategy.note: Only the marked source file region is given; no navigation tools described.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the evaluation results, including the best score, tuning logs, and profiling traces, are returned to AlphaEvolve

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: directly searching over executable C++ implementations that the compiler can compile and evaluate on realistic macro-benchmarks
tool_call_format.note: Model output is C++ code inserted into EVOLVE-BLOCK regions.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The policy-relevant regions are marked with EVOLVE-BLOCK comments, a mechanism provided by AlphaEvolve to delimit editable code.
edit_primitive.note: Edits replace the delimited block; exact edit primitive not specified.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Magellan couples an LLM coding agent with evolutionary search and autotuning in a closed loop of generation, evaluation on user-provided macro-benchmarks, and refinement
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol (MCP/A2A) mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The system operates as a closed-loop process comprising(1) policy pro- posal,(2) local evaluation,(3) hyperparameter tuning, and(4) feedback generation, forming an iterative cycle
loop_primitives.note: Evolutionary search over candidate populations = multi_attempt; four-stage loop = fixed_pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the LLM proposes a heuristic template with symbolic hyperparameters, and an external autotuner later fills in those values
planning_granularity.note: Heuristic template is the artifact, not a stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a hierarchical search strategy thatseparates high-level policy design from low-level parameter tuning
multi_agent_topology.note: LLM proposer and Vizier autotuner hand off in fixed sequence; the autotuner is not an LLM agent, so `single` is also defensible.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: After a fixed number of tuning rounds, the best-performing configuration is returned to AlphaEvolve as feedback for further policy refinement.
delegation_mechanism.note: Hand-off is to a blackbox autotuner (Vizier), not another LLM agent.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Magellan, an autonomous framework for discovering compiler optimization heuristics
human_in_loop.note: No approval/confirmation step described in the four-stage loop.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: AlphaEvolve then performs an evolutionary search over policy templates, using these signals together with the empirical reward to select promising candidates and generate new variants
short_term_state.note: A program database of scored candidates constitutes state beyond a message list.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: using these signals together with the empirical reward to select promising candidates and gen- erate new variants for the next iteration
long_term_memory.note: Population of past candidates+scores; within-run rather than across runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: we take the best-performing heuristic produced by Gemini-2.5-Pro and use it as the initialization seed for Gemini-3-Pro
state_persistence.note: Continuation from a prior run's best candidate.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we rebuild the compiler and execute the resulting toolchain on the benchmark suite, reporting metrics such as binary size (e.g., via llvm-size) or runtime performance (e.g., via perf stat )
self_verification.note: Harness compiles and benchmarks each candidate; compile failure counts as invalid sample.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The system then evaluates the new candidate and repeats the loop, iteratively refining the policy template through successive rounds of selection and variation.
retry_policy.note: Iterates until search budget exhausted; no fixed N per task stated.

rollback.evidence_quote: The synthesized template is then automatically inserted into the LLVM codebase for evaluation.
rollback.note: No undo/reset mechanism described; each candidate is a fresh edit.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: After a fixed number of tuning rounds, the best-performing configuration is returned to AlphaEvolve
termination_condition.note: Also wall-clock search windows (1.5 days, one week) reported in Sec. 3.1/3.3.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: once a policy template compiles, the autotuner can explore many hyperparameter settings without regenerating the policy, and in particular without re- peatedly recompiling the compiler
cost_controls.note: Sampling-efficiency design, not a token/cost budget mechanism.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we rebuild the compiler and execute the resulting toolchain on the benchmark suite
execution_isolation.note: Isolation boundary not stated; local build/execute implied.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The policy-relevant regions are marked with EVOLVE-BLOCK comments, a mechanism provided by AlphaEvolve to delimit editable code.
filesystem_access.note: Model edits are confined to delimited blocks in one source file.

permission_model.evidence_quote: a mechanism provided by AlphaEvolve to delimit editable code
permission_model.note: EVOLVE-BLOCK delimiters act as the only allowlisted edit region; no per-action authorisation described.

tracing.evidence_quote: the evaluation results, including the best score, tuning logs, and profiling traces, are returned to Al- phaEvolve

replayability.evidence_quote: we take the best policy produced by Magellan in Fig. 3 and assess its temporal generalization
replayability.note: Artifacts are re-evaluated; no trajectory replay facility described.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: evaluated on representative macro-benchmarks to obtain an end-to-end reward signal
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark evaluation is intrinsic to the loop; no separate public repo evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The legality of an inlining decision is checked before invoking the heuris- tic using the existing MLInlineAdvisor infrastructure. This ensures that, for any policy that integrates successfully into the compiler, the compiler's output is always correct.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Magellan, an agentic framework that evolves the compiler pass itself by synthesizing executable C++ decision logic
target_domain.note: Domain is compiler heuristic discovery; closest listed value is `other` (code synthesis but not repo-level SWE tasks).

open_source.evidence_quote: Our experiments are conducted on Google's internal clang/LLVM toolchain
open_source.note: No repo_url given for Magellan; built on proprietary AlphaEvolve and Vizier.

model_agnostic.note: Multiple Gemini models swapped in; non-Google providers not demonstrated.
